_comment: Copy this file to playbook.local.json and set your own values. playbook.local.json is never committed.
It is read on top of playbook.default.json; leave out any key you do not need. A key or a password never goes here:
give the Hugging Face token through the HF_TOKEN environment variable.

gpu-box-frame._comment: A llama.cpp server on another computer of your network, as the frame model reads frames.

gpu-box-document._comment: The same server, as the document model writes the document.

providerSets._note: Other machines that run a model for this one. A set links each job to a model of the models above by its name; a job it does not name keeps the default model. A job picks a set by name; jobs on different sets run at the same time, jobs on one set one after another. Remove the sets you do not use.
